title: More readable product titles
summary: Replace compressed uppercase product headings with natural-case typography and comfortable line spacing.

changes.detail: Remove the heavy uppercase display style; use semibold natural-case text, 1.3 line height and smaller responsive sizes (22px on mobile for long titles). Preserve the full product title, including size and condition details.

validation.detail: Focused lint and responsive browser checks pending. No deployment.
